input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research free-choice draw; took grid-linopf milestone 2b (screened QP), which became an audit of the repair's QP solver against Clarabel
errors: First Clarabel arm run counted QP rows after the solver branch, so its rows column read 0; fixed and the arm rerun (identical results, 260 s vs 277 s).

doc_friction.issue: The free-choice draw suggests any programme, but most programmes' next steps need data hosts (ped.fz-juelich.de, zenodo, doi.org) that the proxy refused with 403 in this session; society-lanes milestone 2 was the natural pick and was unreachable. Probing hosts first (research/CLAUDE.md) saved time; a per-programme 'data reachable from cloud sessions' flag in pick_track.py would save more.

pyenv.py installed pytest/scipy/pypower but infra-dcopf's package __init__ imports pandapower, which pyenv was not asked for; a project-level requirements list (pyproject lists only numpy, pandapower) would have avoided a second install. Added pypower and clarabel to the project's pyproject.

deviations.why: Milestone 2b named a screened QP for run time; exploratory runs showed the screened and full PIPS solves diverge because PIPS fails on solvable QPs, so the step was widened to a solver audit with an independent referee (Clarabel) before the 36-case runs, with the exploratory observations disclosed in the plan.
deviations.did: pre-registered H5-H9 covering the audit, screening and a Clarabel arm
deviations.result: 3 held, 1 refuted, 1 at the bar; Clarabel adopted for later milestones

goal: advance an open research programme with a real-benchmark result
notes: Verification: infra-dcopf tests 43 passed (python3.13); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; programme_check ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok; Clarabel arXiv id checked against its PyPI BibTeX (arXiv unreachable). Results: audit of 347 QPs, PIPS objectives match Clarabel on all 236 both solve; PIPS fails 36/99 elastic QPs, 26 solvable; Clarabel arm 21/34 fully clean (31 with R) vs 19 (29), 4.9-5.2x faster; screened 21 (29), 2.99x.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
